subject.title: feat(agents): add iteration budget for agent loop safety

question: Should OpenClaw accept `agents.*.iterationBudget`, `onBeforeToolCallingRound`, and `supportsIterationBudget` with disabled-by-default budgeting and fail-closed unsupported harnesses as the public contract for this safety feature?
rationale: The patch appears technically sound, but this is a new config and plugin/harness API surface whose names, defaults, support matrix, and fail-closed behavior become upgrade-sensitive once shipped.

options.title: Accept the opt-in contract
options.body: Resolve the merge conflict and land the disabled-by-default budget feature with the current fail-closed harness requirement as intentional behavior.

options.title: Narrow the surface first
options.body: Keep the enforcement internal or rename/rework the config and harness APIs before merge if maintainers want a smaller public contract.

options.title: Pause for unified loop policy
options.body: Hold or close this PR if maintainers want one consolidated loop-safety design across runRetries, tools.loopDetection, and per-channel budgets first.

recommendation.title: Accept the opt-in contract
recommendation.body: Resolve the merge conflict and land the disabled-by-default budget feature with the current fail-closed harness requirement as intentional behavior.
